PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -I - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
fixtures = root / 'corpus/fixtures'
names = sorted(p.name for p in fixtures.iterdir() if p.is_dir())
receipt = json.loads((root / '.ufo/waves/round-92/patches/B1-tuples.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
head_checker = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:corpus/fixtures/check_bible.py'], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
checker_bytes = (fixtures / 'check_bible.py').read_bytes()
rows = {}
for name in names:
    rel = f'corpus/fixtures/{name}'
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', 'corpus/fixtures/check_bible.py', rel], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    rows[rel] = {'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(), 'violation_count': sum(line.startswith(b'VIOLATION:') for line in result.stdout.splitlines())}
missing = sorted(set(receipt) - set(rows)); extra = sorted(set(rows) - set(receipt))
diffs = sorted(path for path in set(rows) & set(receipt) if rows[path] != receipt[path])
print(f'HEAD={subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()}')
print(f'fixture_dirs={len(names)} B1_rows={len(receipt)}')
print(f'exit_counts={dict(sorted({code: sum(row["exit"] == code for row in rows.values()) for code in {row["exit"] for row in rows.values()}}.items()))} violation_lines={sum(row["violation_count"] for row in rows.values())}')
print(f'stderr_nonempty={sum(bool(subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "corpus/fixtures/check_bible.py", f"corpus/fixtures/{name}"], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).stderr) for name in names)}')
print(f'checker_sha256={hashlib.sha256(checker_bytes).hexdigest()} head_checker_equal={checker_bytes == head_checker}')
print(f'missing={len(missing)} extra={len(extra)} tuple_mismatches={len(diffs)}')
print(f'mismatch_paths={diffs}')
PY
